localizedValues.name: Y16
localizedValues.description: Each yurt is 16 feet in diameter by 10 feet high and furnished with bunk beds that sleep three and a queen-size futon. Outside is a small deck (ADA-compliant), picnic table and fire grill, with bathrooms and showers nearby. The yurts have one overhead light, one outlet and a heater. A nearby pad with electricity and water hookup for RV or trailer is available for $41 per night at the park. No pets, no cooking, no smoking inside of yurt.
